messages:
sara_cs: FYI MapleFin onboarding — p95 chat latency jumped to ~1.9s and error rate ~3% over the last 30m. Renewal in 3w. Think it's model choice + short-seq overhead. Any quick levers?

miguel_se: what's the split by prompt length + model? can you drop the dashboard?

sara_cs: dashboard: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/maplefin (internal) Topline: 70% requests <=32 tokens, 25% 32-128, rest >128. Currently routing all traffic to rw-7b-compat. Token cost + p95 spiking.

anya_ml: short prompts hitting rw-7b is expensive and adds latency. Quick wins: route short requests to rw-3b-int8, enable prefix KV cache, and use an optimized int8 quant profile. Start with 10% canary.

sam_ae: quality risk? will customer notice before renewal if we swap model for short queries?

anya_ml: for single-turn snippets like theirs, regression should be minimal. I'll run a 200-sample eval from their prompt set now — should have numbers in ~30m. If delta small, proceed with canary.

sara_cs: sounds good. can you paste the canary config so I can share with MapleFin and product?

anya_ml: ```yaml
routing:
  - condition: req.tokens <= 32
    model: rw-3b-int8
    weight: 0.1
  - condition: default
    model: rw-7b-compat
prefix_cache: enabled
quant_profile: optimized-int8
canary_window_seconds: 3600
```

miguel_se: for Dedicated customers we can also pin to a low-latency GPU or allow burst pool; for MapleFin (hosted) routing change + int8 helps most. I'll keep an eye on infra metrics.

sara_cs: I'll message MapleFin: "Proposing a 10% canary to rw-3b-int8 for short queries; will expand to 100% if no regressions in 1h." Sam, you ok with wording + renewal touchpoint?

sam_ae: yep, I'll craft the message and include a short acceptance test. also will capture customer sentiment via the feedback form after the smoke.

deploy-bot: deploy started: routing-rule create job id cj-9987 · logs: https://ci.redwood/deploys/cj-9987

anya_ml: quick eval done: 200 prompts -> avg latency -45%, p95 down below 800ms for short prompts, quality delta ~ -0.6% (within our threshold). Recommend proceed with canary.

sara_cs: rolling to 10% now. @sam_ae I'll post an update in the renewal thread after 1h. :thumbsup:

miguel_se: watching KV cache / thrash. ping me if p95 > 1s or error_rate climbs.

sara_cs: capturing notes in client doc: https://redwood.internal/clients/maplefin/ops-notes — will collate eval results and customer feedback. thanks team!
